description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Agents of HYDRA, adding {C}{C}.
When Agents of HYDRA dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger,
Resolve the Agents of HYDRA trigger, creating a creature token.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Agents of HYDRA from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.
